name: ChartCharacters
description: Represents characters in an object that contains text.
remarks: The ChartCharacters object lets you modify any sequence of characters contained in the full text string. Use Characters ( _Start_ , _Length_ ), where _Start_ is the start character number and _Length_ is the number of characters, to return a ChartCharacters object.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent for the specified object. Read-only Object.

properties.name: Caption
properties.description: Returns the text of this range of characters. Read-only String.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns the number of objects in the collection. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Font
properties.description: Returns the font of the specified object. Read-only ChartFont.

properties.name: Text
properties.description: Returns or sets the text for the specified object. Read/write String.

properties.name: PhoneticCharacters
properties.description: Returns or sets the phonetic text for the object. Read/write String.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application. When used with an object qualifier, returns an Application object that represents the creator of the specified object (you can use this property with an Automation object to return the application of that object). Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

methods.name: Insert
methods.description: Inserts a string preceding the selected characters.
